editorial:
Imagine a world where two of your favorite comic book heroes meet long before the big movie franchises existed. You get to see Dr. David Banner fighting for his life in court after being framed for a crime he did not do. The vibe is a mix of a tense legal drama and a superhero story. You will love seeing the chemistry between the stressed-out Banner and his lawyer, Matt Murdock. Since Matt is secretly Daredevil, you get this cool layer of mystery where both men are hiding massive secrets from each other while trying to beat the system. 

What really makes this work is the acting and the slow build-up of tension. While the special effects are a bit dated, the story keeps you hooked because you just want to see if Banner can keep his temper in check. It is a bit slow in the middle, but the payoff with Wilson Fisk is worth it. If you are a fan of old-school Marvel, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you really love these characters, look for a physical copy to add to your collection for the best quality.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a big showdown where the truth finally comes out. Wilson Fisk tries to manipulate the situation, but Daredevil uses his skills to help Banner escape the trap. Banner manages to control the Hulk just enough to stop the bad guys without destroying everything. In the end, the charges are dropped, and Banner is free to go. He and Matt share a moment of mutual respect, knowing they both lead double lives.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Marvel characters and legal dramas.
